name: Pandarian Dragon Turtle
section: Chapter 3, Professions and Gear, Mounts and Vehicles
sourceWitness: Readable full capture of the Wizards of the Coast digital stat block published in a review of the expansion’s mounts.
sourceNotes: The digital block shows initiative +1 (11), proficiency bonus +2 and six saving-throw modifiers. Each saving throw equals its printed ability modifier.
The attack applies the Grappled condition to creatures of Large size or smaller. The escape DC is 13.

The publisher’s contents page links to the exact Chapter 3 block. The public image shows the publisher’s complete digital rules and carries no folio. The 5e.tools data supplies p. 104 as a secondary locator.
appearanceEvidence: The block identifies a Large dragon turtle and the mount article identifies its use. The available rules capture supplies no physical description. The existing portrait illustrates the named form.
habitatEvidence: The available stat block supplies no habitat line.
artworkNote: Reused the indexed square parchment portrait for this exact creature. I checked the 1254-by-1254 image and confirmed its SHA-256.
